description: A 20-line JSON config registers two providers (ollama and openwebui) in opencode, each using the openai-compatible npm package with separate base URLs and model names so both appear in /models.

steps.description: The config creates the opencode directory, then writes a JSON file with a provider map containing ollama (baseURL localhost:11434/v1, model llama3.2) and openwebui (baseURL localhost:3000/api/v1, apiKey placeholder, model llama3.2).
Line 2 creates the config directory if it does not exist.
Lines 5-8 define the ollama provider with the raw Ollama endpoint and a descriptive model name.
Lines 10-16 define the openwebui provider with its endpoint, an API key placeholder, and a distinct model name so you can tell them apart in /models.

steps.question: What is the file name opencode expects for its config?

title: opencode Configuration with Ollama and OpenWebUI
